text:
zoe: Hi team — I'm drafting a compact single-file quickstart (serverless) that uses an opt-in credential helper (.redwoodrc) and a tiny CI check. Plan: keep the main quickstart page with tabs: Compact | Full. Will open a PR with atomic commits.
ayan: Nice. For the helper, can we show a minimal JSON file and a .gitignore snippet so folks don't accidentally commit tokens?
zoe: Yes. Example .redwoodrc in the PR and `.redwoodrc` in .gitignore. I'll also add a short security note: do not bake tokens in images.
frida: Please include an "expected stdout" snippet for the CI snippet-runner so examples are deterministic. Last time nondeterministic outputs caused flappers.
zoe: Good call — will add `# expected: Hello, Redwood!` comment and a small yaml check in docs CI.
doc-bot: snippet-runner queued for docs/quickstart at 3204501240.
noah: Also add a one-line "where to find token" pointing to Console -> API keys and a redirect entry for any old /docs/quickstart/auth links. Linkchecker flagged one earlier.
zoe: Will sweep internal links and add redirect. PR ETA ~25m, tagging @frida @ayan for review.
doc-bot: snippet-runner finished: 0 errors, 0 warnings.
ayan: I'll run the docker and serverless examples and check the CI snippet.
zoe: Thanks everyone — will post PR link here when open and squash fixes after reviews. Closing after merge. :sparkles:
